entities.summary: Panteha Abareshi is a Canadian-born American multidisciplinary artist and curator, primarily working within installation art, video art, and performance art. They are of Jamaican and Iranian descent, and their work is about chronic illness and disability. Abareshi is based in Los Angeles, California. Abareshi identifies with the pronouns they/them/theirs.
